title: IotTopicPublishAction
description: Information required to publish the MQTT message through the AWS IoT message broker.

allOf.description: The MQTT topic of the message. You can use a string expression that includes variables ($variable.<variable-name>) and input values ($input.<input-name>.<path-to-datum>) as the topic string.
You can configure the action payload when you publish a message to an AWS IoT Core topic.
